question: The inpatient database shows a mean stay of 5.5 days. Using the truncated normal model, estimate (a) the true mean length of stay Î¼ across ALL hospital episodes (including day procedures), and (b) the fraction of all hospital episodes that appear in the inpatient database.

from scipy.optimize import brentq
from scipy.stats import norm
def eq(mu): a=(3-mu)/2; sf=norm.sf(a); return mu+2*norm.pdf(a)/sf-5.5 if sf>1e-10 else 1e10
mu=brentq(eq,4,5.4)
